head: codex/5872-resource-weather
title: feat(runtime): add authenticated resource weather
body:
Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5872

## Summary
- add bounded deterministic resource-weather observations signed by AdvertisementSigning certificates
- enforce live authorization, freshness, durable replay and authenticated withdrawal semantics
- fail closed on malformed, corrupt, oversized, replayed, or unsafe-path state
- keep the module unregistered and advisory-only until #5878

## Validation
- exact nextest target: 12/12 passed
- qualified strict Clippy: passed (allowing only the known unrelated acip.rs baseline lint)
- two-revision receipt validator: passed
- independent exact-head security/correctness review: accepted with no material findings

## Residual boundary
Stable-state path checks reject relative and symlinked components but do not claim race-free filesystem confinement. Production registration and cross-child integration remain deferred to #5878.
